_comment: Secant check of the 90-day frozen-mixing, frozen-buoyancy-gradient adjoint (1157589): finite differences of the 30-day-mean AMOC along the stress gradient at h = 0.1, 0.05, 0.025 N m⁻², as ecco4_nz20_90day_frozen did for frozen mixing on 0.113.5 (2.2 %). The frozen adjoint is not the exact derivative, so the Taylor verdict may fail; the secant slopes are the result.
